text:
deploy-bot: Initiating staged rollout: service=runtime-api model=rw-v1.3.0 -> 8% traffic to canary in us-central1. change_window=02:00-05:00 UTC. release_notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/1.3.0
reza: heads-up, this builds in the new attention-kernel experiment. small perf risk flagged by bench.
maya: confirmed change window OK. ops oncall pinged.
luis: immediate ask: can we isolate canary to a dedicated subnet to avoid cross-az cache thrash?
anika: yes, routing rule applied: canary->subnet-canary-us. pinning old nodes out of rotation.
qa-bot: smoke checklist posted: latency check, error budget delta, mem OOMs, kernel errors, model-response-smoke.
reza: thresholds: tail p99 +200ms OR 5xx > 0.4% OR mem-ooms >=1/min -> stop.
maya: who has abort rights? release_lead + infra lead.
luis: infra lead = reza, release_lead = maya. noted.
deploy-bot: shift started at 6112233445. canary pods: can-rw-21, can-rw-22. health=passing. logs: https://logs.redwood/internal/rollouts/6112233445
qa-bot: starting synthetic probes against canary set (short prompts / long prompts / embeddings).
reza: seeing slight p99 increase on tiny prompts (+120ms) and a few kernel WARNs. not at threshold yet. watching.
maya: schedule: wait 8 minutes then decide go->20% if stable.
qa-bot: probe report @6112233470: p50 +5ms, p95 +45ms, p99 +130ms, 5xx 0.03%, mem-oom 0/min. kernel-warn count=3 (nonfatal).
luis: kernel warn looks like alignment in the new kernel, not crashing. but could add CPU spin on small inputs.
anika: we can throttle concurrency on canary pods to reduce spin; want to try softened concurrency (cgroup tweak) before abort.
maya: agree. try soft-concurrency=4 on canary pool. reza you OK to apply?
reza: applying change now. command: ```kubectl patch deployment canary-runtime -n prod -p '{"spec": {"template": {"spec": {"containers": [{"name":"runtime","resources":{"limits":{"cpu":"2"}}}]}}}}'```
luis: after patch watch p99 for next 3m.
qa-bot: probe @6112233490: p99 down to +70ms, p95 +30ms, kernel-warn spike stopped. mem-oom 0. 5xx 0.01%.
maya: that's better. proceed to 20% in 6m if steady. any objections from infra?
reza: none. but keep the rollback command handy: ```kubectl -n prod rollout undo deploy/runtime-api --to-revision=stable-1.2.9```
anika: also prepping a hotfix branch (hotfix/attention-fallback) to gate the kernel behind a runtime flag if we need immediate mitigations.
luis: reminder: change window ends at 05:00 UTC. if we hit a partial rollback after that we may need extended maintenance slot.
maya: copy. ops + release lead will coordinate extended window if necessary.
deploy-bot: status @6112233510: canary=8% -> p99 +72ms, 5xx 0.02%, mem-oom 0/min, kernel-warn=0.
qa-bot: embedding samples show cosine-sim drift 0.4% (within tolerances).
maya: OK let's ramp to 20% at minute mark. reza keep an eye for tail spikes.
reza: watching graphs and alerts. will call stop immediately if threshold breached.
deploy-bot: next update scheduled at 6112233550 or on any status change.
maya: thanks team. pinning rollback and hotfix links in thread.
anika: pinned playbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/rollout-rollback. shortened checklist in doc.
luis: nice. will follow up with postmortem template if we need it.
qa-bot: note: post-rollout evals queued for 30m to catch slow regressions.
